name: Half Hollow Hills Community Library (Dix Hills)
aliases: Half Hollow Hills Library Dix Hills

evidence.note: Library calendar: Almost Elton/Almost Billy, Sun Oct 4, 2-3:30 PM, Lecture Room 111 at Dix Hills, registration required.
Adult events page shows the Oct 4 concert as full, with registration closed.

dancing.notes: Library concerts are held in a lecture room with chairs, and you must register ahead. Expect to sit and sing along rather than dance.

description: The Dix Hills branch of the public library serving the Half Hollow Hills area. It hosts free concerts and programs in its lecture room, usually with sign-up required.
reviewNotes: Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). The library also has a Melville branch (510 Sweet Hollow Rd); the Oct 4 concert is at Dix Hills. The show was already full when checked.
